title: aidd eval claims
description: The format of evals/claims.json: the closed registry of the claims the agent eval suites prove. A case names a claim as `kind:name`. An `action:` claim is an action in schemas/risks.json, a `route:` claim is one of its areas or an outcome listed here, and a `trigger:` claim is a practice skill in schemas/roles.json. Every other claim is listed here under the section of its kind, with the owner that makes it real. Each claim listed is required: a case proves it, or `known_gaps` says why none does yet.

gates.description: The four gates, where a person decides: each gate's name, and the action in schemas/risks.json that the person's yes opens.

stops.description: Each stop a case makes an agent take: its name, and the stop code in schemas/common.schema.json that the agent names in its handoff note.

routes.description: Each route outcome a routing case expects: its name, and the route (minor, normal, major, or emergency) it expects.

duties.description: The duties a case proves, by the role that owns each: a role in schemas/roles.json, or `lead`, the agent that runs the team's flows. Each list is sorted.

triggers.description: The practice skills whose loading a case proves, each a practice in schemas/roles.json.

controls.description: The loop's controls: a rule stated once, with the file that holds it.

principles.description: The principles a case proves, each stated once with the file that holds it. A principle may name the stop code it leads to.

known_gaps.description: A required claim no case proves yet, and why. It only shrinks, so a case that closes a gap removes it. `stop_code:<code>` names a stop code that no stop claim reaches.

source.description: The file in the repository that holds the rule.

stop_code.description: The stop code a run that breaks the rule would have to name.
